title: iDaWiLL - The World Is Ours
htmlContent:
iDaWiLL delivers a wonderful single called "The World Is Ours," that showcases a sound that features perfected blends of afro, hip hop and pop. Follow-up of his recently released singles “Time Nor Day” and "Let’s Make Up".

"The World Is Ours" is a super dope record that shows the creativity that music has to offer. The song has many great elements that work, but one of the more impressive elements is the writing. Truly, this is a stunning piece of music. The music is packed with appeal, with a sound that is digestible for the masses, while still being a master class of musicianship that showcases his talent to the fullest on this one of a kind record.
